# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and platform compatibility**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes improve rendering reliability and update Apple and Uno platform requirements. Android texture rendering follows display refresh, Linux HarfBuzz avoids conflicts with system libraries, and callback interoperability is corrected. Review the Apple deployment floors, Uno 7 migration, and custom WebAssembly archive requirements before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple application deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15, with managed minima aligned for Xcode 27 builds. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, retaining any higher requirement imposed by your framework. These final floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 native baselines in this unreleased line; .NET 9 targets remain supported. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Migrate Uno applications to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI now targets Uno 7, with .NET 10 required for its non-Windows assembly. Upgrade Uno and non-Windows target frameworks, and use Uno.Sdk's native assets and .NET SDK WebAssembly pipeline. The former platform-specific runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell integration are removed. Windows package facades continue to use SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering on Uno** — On non-Windows Uno, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid and hosts a CPU raster canvas. GRContext is null, and PaintSurface supplies a size-and-format backend target with framebuffer zero. Use SKCanvasElement when GPU rendering is required, remove uses of the deleted RaiseOnUnsupported property, and do not rely on DrawInBackground, which remains unsupported. The Windows WinAppSDK control remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Rebuild custom WebAssembly archives for WebGPU linking** — WebGPU C++ support now ships inside libSkiaSharp.a, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources. On .NET 9 and newer, use updated packaged archives or rebuild custom archives with Graphite enabled; older and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy this link contract. JavaScript glue remains a link input, not deployed content. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is unchanged. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 rendering and shader fixes** — Rejects overflowing Raster Pipeline shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types during parsing. Ganesh GL also stops using BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that are invalid in GLES; readback is unchanged. These are same-milestone fixes, not a new engine milestone. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Updated Windows ANGLE renderer** — Advances bundled WinUI ANGLE from chromium/6275 to chromium/8118 and packages matching debug symbols. The native WinUI project's declared Windows 10 build 17763 minimum is unchanged. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of buffer-swap throughput. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests remain independent. Rendering also resumes correctly after rapid render-mode changes. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Linux HarfBuzz library isolation** — Keeps internal calls in the bundled HarfBuzz implementation, preventing incompatible system HarfBuzz functions loaded by GTK from receiving its private objects. The fix covers the common Linux recipe, including nodeps, without changing exported entry points or managed signatures. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Correct native callback boolean widths** — Skia callbacks use one-byte native boolean values, and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values, while public managed signatures retain bool. This corrects callback interoperability, including Apple ARM64 interpreter returns and false-returning HarfBuzz font and Unicode callbacks. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Safer string decoding and validation** — GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates one encoded unit and decodes its byte width correctly: use UTF-32 for supplementary characters, while UTF-8 accepts only single-byte characters. GetString now throws ArgumentNullException for null byte arrays. FromCString also fixes a native buffer over-read. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower pixel-copy and text conversion overhead** — Managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation for valid inputs while retaining native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered stream retention** — Fixes retention behavior in front-buffered streams. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Aligned Windows integration dependencies** — Updates the library dependency baseline to Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 across WinUI, MAUI, Uno, and native WinUI/ANGLE paths, aligning with MAUI 9 and 10. This does not change public APIs or the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
